capabilities: move notes to folders by matching tags or titles against rules
trigger moves automatically on note create, edit, or rename
migrate rules from the original plugin's data.json
extras: Desktop only, untested on mobile. Warns never to run both the original and the fork at the same time. Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Includes migration steps for copying data.json from the original plugin.
intentEvidence: This is a fork of the popular Auto Note Mover plugin by faru
motivation: The original plugin had not been updated in several years; the fork brings it up to date with current versions of Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian leaves notes where you create them, so notes made from links or plugins end up in the wrong folder unless you move them manually.

summary: Rule-based plugin that automatically moves notes to folders when their tag or title matches a rule, on create, edit, rename, or by command.
